meta.title: Mila University | Faculties, Programs & Research in Mila, Algeria
meta.description: Mila University in Algeria: explore our faculties, degree programs in science, technology and economics, research laboratories, campus life and upcoming events.

hero.description: Abdelhafid Boussouf University – Mila is a public scientific and cultural institution providing qualitative scientific training to students in various fields, established by Executive Decree No. 08-204 of July 9, 2008.

rector.name: Prof. Amirouche Bouchelaghem
rector.summary: Born in 1964, a university professor specialising in Economics and Health Economics, dedicated to building qualitative scientific environments for researchers and students across Algeria.

Share open-source designs with other universities
